gaps.GET /v1/agent-credentials/audiences: lists the registered agent credential audiences (third-party enforcement points) and their scope maps
gaps.POST /v1/agent-credentials/audiences: registers an agent credential audience with its algorithm, binding, lifetime and scope map (settings_relax step-up, audited)
gaps.POST /v1/agent-credentials/audiences/:au: disables an agent credential audience: no new credential is issued to it (audited)
